# [TASK] Implement Movie Service

## Task
Movie Service: TMDB-backed discovery, search and movie detail endpoints, with
MongoDB as the persisted store, Redis as the short-lived cache, Bucket4j
limiting outbound TMDB calls, and a Docker image that runs in the compose
stack.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Discover, search, detail, popular, trending and genre endpoints return
      TMDB-shaped responses (`TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest`, `MovieControllerTest`)
- [x] A movie read once is served from MongoDB on the next read with no second
      TMDB call, and outbound TMDB calls stop at 40 per 10 seconds
      (`TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest.secondDetailRequestServedFromMongo`,
      `TmdbClientIntegrationTest.shouldThrottleRequestsWhenExceedingLimit`)
- [x] Health probes, the OpenAPI document and Swagger UI are served, and the
      service registers with Eureka
      (`PrometheusEndpointTest.healthProbesRespond`, `OpenApiDocsTest`, and the
      newman request "Eureka Registry (core services registered)")
- [x] The image builds and the service reports healthy inside the compose
      stack (`.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml`, which runs
      `infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh` nightly)
- [x] Line coverage stays at or above 80%
      (`./gradlew :backend:movie-service:jacocoTestCoverageVerification`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10-12

## Notes
Coverage was written here as 85%. The gate the build enforces is 80%, set in
#108, so the criterion states 80%.

The Redis tier is configuration (`spring.cache.type: redis`) and runs only in
the live stack: every test uses an in-memory cache manager or none. The
MongoDB read-through layer is the part the tests above cover.
